claims.claim: Classic and reliable themocool freezer with long-lasting freezing for up to five...
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a chest-style freezer (lid open) but do not show freezing duration/temperature performance or any test results.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: Photos show scuffs/marks and a dirty/used-looking interior floor; no readable purchase date/receipt is shown.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos do not confirm compressor/motor condition or whether it has been opened/serviced.
No receipt/warranty card is shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Not actually working or weak cooling (compressor/fan/thermostat issues) despite appearance.
risks.proof: A short video of the freezer running: power on, temperature knob set, and a thermometer reading dropping over time (e.g., 10–20 minutes), plus compressor start sound.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: needs testing/possible repair).

risks.risk: Lid seal/gasket leak causing poor temperature retention and higher electricity use.
risks.proof: Close-up shot of the lid gasket condition and a simple leak test: place a thin strip of paper at the seal, close lid, try to pull—show resistance at multiple points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible seal issue (worst case: air leak).

risks.risk: Frost/evaporator/drainage problems leading to uneven freezing or future breakdown.
risks.proof: Photo/clip of interior showing frost level (especially around evaporator area) and whether drainage channel is clear.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown frost/drainage condition (worst case: may need defrost/service).

risks.risk: Interior cleanliness/odor and possible contamination from prior use (dirty floor noted).
risks.proof: Close-up of the interior floor and corners after cleaning attempt (or show it wiped clean) to confirm no residue.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/dirty interior (worst case: needs thorough cleaning).

risks.risk: Physical wear/damage affecting performance or longevity (scuffs/marks near bottom edges).
risks.proof: Close-up of bottom corners/hinge/lock area and any dents/rust; show underside/edges if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically worn (worst case: hidden damage near bottom/hinges).

risks.risk: Capacity/model mismatch (capacity not readable), which changes value significantly.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating plate/model number and capacity label (liters/cubic feet) on the exterior or inside panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely capacity tier for this type/brand until capacity is confirmed.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the rating plate showing exact model number and capacity (liters/cubic feet).
Send a short video showing the freezer powered on and cooling: thermometer reading dropping over time and compressor start.
Show the lid gasket/seal closely (and do a paper-strip seal test at multiple points).
Show frost level inside (especially around the evaporator area) and the drainage/drain channel condition.
Provide photos of the bottom corners/hinge/lock area to confirm no hidden dents/rust.
Show the receipt and warranty card (clear, readable).
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a chest-style Haier Thermocool freezer, so it can be priced at its worst-case used/unknown-working condition. Seller claims about being barely used and fault-free are not verifiable from the photos, so the price should reflect testing/possible service risk.
